title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-19
lineage: AUD > MC > Reel > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording with fair fidelity captures a high‑energy August ’70 set highlighted by Cold Rain & Snow, Easy Wind and an electrifying NFA > Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The show delivers strong electric momentum – Cold Rain & Snow opens tight, Easy Wind is classic, and the NFA > Lovelight sequence shines as a top‑tier performance. The audience tape is uneven: acoustic portions are muffled, organ barely audible and occasional high‑end distortion, but the electric set comes through loud and clear enough to enjoy.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are mixed; several songs receive strong praise while recording fidelity is uneven, yielding an overall moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Acoustic portion muffled and slightly chopped; organ barely audible, high‑end distortion in spots, some tape hiss but electric set is loud and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first electric set builds solid energy, though the acoustic side is weak; the second half peaks with NFA > Lovelight and maintains momentum through rare gems like Cocaine Blues.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's piano comes through strongly while organ is barely audible in this audience tape.
